items.source: Resolve the supplied placeholder name to the replacement value.
items.translation: 将提供的占位符名称解析为替换值。

items.source: placeholderName - the name of the placeholder to resolve
the replacement value, or null if no replacement is to be made
items.translation: 替换值，或者如果不进行替换则为null

items.source: Strategy interface used to resolve replacement values for placeholders contained in Strings.
items.translation: 用于解析字符串中占位符的替换值的策略接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Stephane Nicoll
